answer: Price the attack before defending it. One clone costs a bond, three audits, and six epochs of unpayable work, and its history has to read like a crystal of consistent receipts rather than one template repeated. Publish every failure with the identity's full record and forbid auditing your own recruit. A farm of a thousand clones then looks like a lagoon of quiet accounts on one basalt slab of hosting, and the cluster detector reads that slab in a single pass.
